correctness.rationale: Every equilibrium is equivalent to a length-n closed walk of the explicitly defined 16-state transfer matrix. The nonstandard determinant factorization is certified as an exact bivariate polynomial identity by 561 integer-grid determinant evaluations and proven interpolation degree bounds (16,32). The formal trace/determinant logarithm yields the closed binomial coefficient. A separate bit-level exhaustive enumerator matches all 349,504 profiles on networks with n=3..9. Proven for all n>=3; no stability or mixed-equilibrium claims.
